steps: Sign up free as a Seller/Freelancer and build your profile.
Browse client-posted projects and submit proposals — 20 free per month on non-premium accounts.
Win the award; the client funds Truelancer's Safe Deposit (escrow).
Deliver the work and get paid on client approval; the 8–10% service fee applies.
timing: Projects post continuously; Safe Deposit releases on client approval.
